messages:
Ava: Prototype -> https://figma.com/file/abc123/prompt-sets-evals-compact
Ava: Quick sync — wanted feedback on two things: (1) secondary action priority in the eval run toolbar (approve / bulk-undo / more...) and (2) how we show pending approvals in long runs.
Diego: Nice. For toolbar: secondary actions are too visually heavy. Approve should be primary (solid), others should be ghost buttons. Right now everything reads like equal weight.
Sam: Agreed. Current spacing too dense, makes keyboard focus hard to see. Suggest adding 8px between buttons and reduce label verbosity (e.g., 'Bulk undo' -> 'Undo batch').
Priya: Accessibility: focus ring is low-contrast on the gray bg. We need a 3:1 contrast for focus, or ideally 4.5:1. Also ensure :focus-visible only shows for keyboard — don't hide focus entirely.
Jared: Quick CSS proposal:
```css
.toolbar button { margin-left: 8px; }
button.primary { background: #0b5fff; color: #fff; }
button.ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb86b; outline-offset: 2px; }
```
Ava: Nice — what about the pending approvals? current plan was a small ribbon per run card (top-left) showing 'X awaiting approval'. Does that scale for 500+ runs?
Diego: Ribbon works for short lists but gets noisy. Maybe collapse into a compact badge with count + hover details. Keep ribbon only for runs with >50 pending to draw attention.
Sam: Also add filter/quick-sort 'Needs approval' so users can filter runs rather than scanning ribbons.
Priya: For screen readers, the ribbon/badge needs aria-live polite announcements when it changes (e.g., when a run moves from 2->0). Also role='status' with text '2 items awaiting approval'.
Ava: UX copy tweak: instead of 'Approve all' maybe 'Approve visible' to avoid accidental approval of hidden items.
Jared: +1. Also propose a confirmation toast that says 'Approved 12 items — undo' (with undo CTA) rather than modal.
Sam: One more: scorecard mini-counts — show pass/fail icons inline next to run title to speed scan. tiny icons + numbers.
Ava: Great, I'll update figma and post a new iteration. If someone can mock the focus ring and ribbon hover detail by EOD that'd be awesome. :thumbsup: 
UIBot: Created task #4523 from this thread: 'Toolbar density & pending approvals UX tweaks' — assignee: Sam.
Sam: I'll take it. Starting a branch for toolbar spacing + CSS focus.
